blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Model building (model banana) ka role (kirdaar) aur importance, aur real life mein iske uses, samajh sakenge.
Real life ke maslon ke liye basic statistical models (data par mabni models) bana sakenge aur unki performance (kitna sahi chalte hain) jaanch sakenge.
Data science mein experimental design (tajurbe ka khaka) samajh aur samjha sakenge.
Data visualization (data ko chart ya tasveer se dikhana) ki types, uses aur tareeqe bata sakenge.
Descriptive statistics (data ki summary batane wale numbers) ke zariye data dikhane ke faide samajh sakenge.
Visualization software, jaise MS Excel, Google Sheets, Python, Tableau ya Matplotlib, se data visualization bana aur samjha sakenge.

blocks.text: Model building ka matlab hai kisi complex (uljhe hue) masle ki ek simplified representation (saada shakal) banana. Is mein sirf key elements (aham hisson) par focus (dhyan) kiya jata hai. Is se asal zindagi ke problems (masle) ko samajhna, analyze karna (jaanchna) aur hal karna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Model kya chhor deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Model unnecessary details (faltu baatein) chhor deta hai, ta ke dhyan masle ke sab se aham hisson par rahe.

items: Model building: complex masle ki saada shakal banana jis mein sirf aham hisse rakhe jate hain.
